summary: The proof correctly constructs a centrally symmetric measurable subset of S with total mass Phi(c), uses finite-measure inclusion-exclusion to retain all boundary mass, and obtains at least half that mass in every boundary-through-y closed halfspace. The predecessor fact then extends the bound to every proper closed halfspace containing y, while the whole-space degenerate case is correctly checked using Phi(c) <= T. The consequence follows with the stated constant, and membership holds because c is in A_1.
